content.short: UFO Gaming is a space-themed Web3 gaming studio built on the Immutable X network, featuring NFT and DeFi elements.
content.description: UFO Gaming is an interstellar-themed Web3 gaming studio that aims to blend NFT and DeFi elements into immersive games. Most titles run on the Immutable X chain, providing smooth transactions and micro gas fees. Its first game, Super Galactic, will feature a play-to-earn rewards mechanic alongside a dedicated NFT marketplace and breeding system.
